name: Twenty-Six
description: Twenty-Six is a trick-taking round game in the Cucumber/Twenty-Two family. Suits irrelevant; rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2. Players lead single cards or sets of equal rank; others must equal or beat the highest played, or play lowest. Winner of the last trick is penalised (e.g. keeps losing card or gets penalty points). For 2-6 players, 52 cards.

content.text: Twenty-Six is a trick-taking round game in the Cucumber/Twenty-Two family. Suits irrelevant; rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3-2. Players lead single cards or sets of equal rank; others must equal or beat the highest played, or play lowest. Winner of the last trick is penalised (e.g. keeps losing card or gets penalty points). For 2-6 players, 52 cards.

Twenty-Six belongs to the Twenty-Two family of round, last-trick-penalty card games. Twenty-Two is a North American game based on the Icelandic version of the Nordic game Cucumber (Gúrka), in which the winner of the last trick is penalised and players must equal or beat the highest card played or play their lowest. Cucumber spread through Scandinavia and North Europe from the mid-20th century; the North American form uses a standard 52-card pack. The name Twenty-Six can refer to the standard game or to a variant played with a double deck and jokers in which players are eliminated at 26 points.
52 cards; for 6+ use multiple packs (one per ~4 players)
Seven cards each (or varies by variant).
